# ledger_user (Resource)

A Ledger user account: a username, an optional display name and a role. **Ledger never deletes users**: destroying this resource **disables** the user (their sessions and tokens stop working, audit history and token ownership stay) and removes it from state. Credentials are separate: set a password with `ledger_user_password` (write-only). User routes need an API token with the `users:read` and `users:write` grants. Creating or promoting an administrator, re-enabling a disabled administrator, and changing the root (first) account need the **root token** of the root account; any other token is refused with `root_token_required`.

Import with the identifier: `terraform import ledger_user.example <id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A Ledger user. Ledger never deletes users: destroying this resource disables the user.
# Needs an API token with users:read and users:write. Creating or promoting an administrator needs the root token.
resource "ledger_user" "reader" {
  username     = "alex"
  display_name = "Alex Example"
  role         = "read-only"
}

# Disable a user without removing it from the configuration.
resource "ledger_user" "former_member" {
  username = "sam"
  role     = "read-only"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) `administrator` (every grant) or `read-only` (read on non-administrative resources). Making a user an administrator needs the root token; Ledger refuses a change that would leave no enabled administrator.
- `username` (String) The sign-in name, 1 to 64 characters: lower-case letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or digit. It can be renamed in place; renaming the root account needs the root token. A name that is taken is refused.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is disabled. Defaults to `false`. Re-enabling a disabled administrator needs the root token.
- `display_name` (String) An optional display name, 1 to 100 characters. Remove the attribute to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the user was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `disabled_at` (String) When the user was disabled (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier (a ULID).
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version. Changes are sent against the version Terraform last read; a stale one fails instead of overwriting.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By identifier
terraform import ledger_user.reader 01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA
```
